name: Chateau Saint-Martin & Spa
positioning: Oetker Collection hotel in Vence on the French Riviera, with suites that look out over the hills, the gardens and the sea
best_for: Couples who want a suite with a private balcony, terrace or loggia
Travelers who want sea or hillside views above the French Riviera
Guests who like spa treatments in the privacy of their room

facts.text: The hotel is at 2490 Avenue des Templiers in Vence, France.
The Deluxe Room has an open aspect over the hillside.
The Classic Junior Suite has garden and sea views.
The Prestige Junior Suite has a generous balcony.
The Junior Suite L'Atelier has a private loggia.
Spa treatments are available in the privacy of the guest's room for a minimum of one hour.
Guestrooms have 'The Giving Bag', in which guests can donate items such as clothes to charity, benefiting the Red Cross and Secours Populaire.
The hotel offers gift experiences that can be cultural, gastronomic, wellbeing or romantic.

highlights.text: The Duplex Suite has a bedroom on the top floor of the tower.
The Junior Suite L'Atelier includes a bathroom with a hammam shower.
The One-Bedroom Suite has a private terrace with views across the Cote d'Azur.
The Duplex Suite has a private balcony adjoining the living room with views over the French Riviera.

considerations.text: In-room spa treatments cost an extra 25% on the listed spa menu price.
WhataHotel notes the hillside location requires transportation to nearby attractions.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing that reflects the hotel's exclusive positioning.
